blog_posts.title: When to replace your roof in Stockport
blog_posts.excerpt: Signs your roof may need replacing and what to consider before starting work
blog_posts.body:
Most roofs in Stockport last between 20 and 50 years, depending on materials. Slate roofs often last the longest, while felt and other flat roofing materials may need replacing sooner.

Look for missing or broken tiles, leaks in your loft, or daylight showing through the roof boards. If your roof is sagging or you notice granules in your gutters, these are also signs that replacement may be needed.

Before committing to a full re-roof, get a professional inspection. We can check the condition of your roof structure and advise whether repair or replacement is the best option for your home.

blog_posts.title: Choosing slate for heritage homes in Stockport
blog_posts.excerpt: How to select the right slate for period properties and what to expect from the process
blog_posts.body:
Heritage homes in Stockport often require traditional materials to maintain their character. Natural slate is the most authentic choice for period properties, with different colours and textures available to match your home's original roof.

When selecting slate, consider the thickness, size and colour that best suits your property. Welsh slate is a popular choice for its durability and classic appearance, while local slate can sometimes be sourced for a more authentic match.

The installation process for heritage slate work is more time-consuming than modern roofing methods. Each slate must be carefully cut and fixed to ensure a watertight finish that will last for decades. Our team has experience working on listed buildings and conservation areas across Stockport.
